meta.direction: Dark only. The visual language of Forge AIOS, a browser cockpit for live Claude Code sessions. LCARS frame blended with Windows 8 Metro, in Anvil Digital black and gold.

tokens.name: anvil-black
tokens.usage: The ground: page background, the gaps between frame segments, and the text on every coloured fill (gold, sand, bronze, steel, status). The black of the anvil in the Anvil Digital logo.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards and the auth panel, flat on `anvil-black`. No border, no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, the message body and neutral tiles; one step up from `surface-1`.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover fill of table rows and neutral tiles; disabled button fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only group, never carry meaning: table row dividers, the rule inside a card. Decorative, so it is exempt from the 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of inputs and selects: about 4.0:1 on `surface-2` and 4.9:1 on `anvil-black`, above the 3:1 floor for controls.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `anvil-black` (19:1), `surface-1` and `surface-2` (15.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, subtitles, field labels, empty states and the signed-in name: 8.3:1 on `anvil-black`, 7.4:1 on `surface-1`, 6.8:1 on `surface-2`, 6.0:1 on `surface-3`.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text of disabled inputs on `surface-1`. Disabled controls are exempt from contrast minimums; never use it for live text.

tokens.name: anvil-gold
tokens.usage: The brand colour, from the circuit traces of the Anvil Digital v2 logo. The frame (elbow and top bar), the active nav block, primary buttons and the input focus border. Text on it is `anvil-black` (12.6:1). As text on `anvil-black` it reads at 12.6:1; use that sparingly, for the auth eyebrow.

tokens.name: anvil-gold-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons: gold lightened, which reads as lit on a dark ground. `anvil-black` text is 14.6:1. Derived for this system; not in the logo.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Pale gold. Nav blocks on hover, table column headers as text on `anvil-black` (15:1), and the second tile colour. `anvil-black` text on it is 15.2:1.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Deep gold. The sidebar spine below the nav, card header caps and bars, and the third tile colour. `anvil-black` text on it is 6.8:1. As text on `anvil-black` it reads at 6.8:1, but keep it a fill; text roles belong to `ink`, `ink-muted` and `sand`.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: The neutral fill: inactive nav blocks, secondary buttons and the Sign out cap. `anvil-black` text on it is 6.5:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: the Message cap fill (`anvil-black` text, 7.3:1) and destructive text actions on `anvil-black` (7.3:1) or `surface-1` (6.5:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success: the Message cap fill (`anvil-black` text, 11.8:1). It differs from `danger` by hue more than lightness (1.6:1 between them), so the cap always carries the word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings: the Message cap fill (`anvil-black` text, 8.8:1). Close to the golds, so a warning must always say WARNING in its cap.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, so it always lands on `anvil-black` or a surface (21:1 on `anvil-black`). White keeps it distinct from the gold frame; it is only 1.7:1 against gold itself, which is why the offset gap is required.

tokens.name: agent-gold
tokens.usage: Agent colour 1, always the main session. The same gold as the frame, so the main session reads as the cockpit's own voice.

tokens.name: agent-teal
tokens.usage: Agent colour 2 (subagents are coloured in spawn order). `anvil-black` text on it: 11.7:1.

tokens.name: agent-ice
tokens.usage: Agent colour 3. `anvil-black` text: 11.9:1.

tokens.name: agent-lilac
tokens.usage: Agent colour 4. `anvil-black` text: 10.9:1.

tokens.name: agent-peach
tokens.usage: Agent colour 5. `anvil-black` text: 11.0:1. Close to `warning`, so it never appears without the agent's name beside it.

tokens.name: agent-lime
tokens.usage: Agent colour 6. `anvil-black` text: 14.9:1.

tokens.name: agent-rose
tokens.usage: Agent colour 7. `anvil-black` text: 10.3:1.

tokens.name: agent-cloud
tokens.usage: Agent colour 8, then the cycle restarts at `agent-teal`. `anvil-black` text: 15.9:1.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Status pill fill: RUNNING. `anvil-black` text.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Status pill fill: WAITING (for your approval). Also the approval card's header bar and the pending-approvals count in the top bar.

tokens.name: status-queued
tokens.usage: Status pill fill: QUEUED, for a steering note that hasn't been delivered yet; also the NOTE marker on the timeline.

tokens.name: status-stopping
tokens.usage: Status pill fill: STOPPING, from pressing Stop until the subagent reports back.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Status pill fill: DONE, and STOPPED BY YOU.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Status pill fill: ERROR. Shares `danger` with STOPPING; the word tells them apart.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, uppercase, in `ink`: PageHeader and AuthShell titles.

styles.name: tile-value
styles.usage: The one number on a Tile, top-left, in `anvil-black` on a coloured tile or `ink` on `surface-2`.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Uppercase card titles, sitting in the gap of the card's header bar, in `ink`.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Sidebar nav blocks, uppercase, bottom-right aligned, `anvil-black` on the block; also the brand name in the elbow.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button label, uppercase, `anvil-black` on the fill.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and tile labels (`ink-muted`, or `anvil-black` on a tile), Message cap words, the auth eyebrow in `anvil-gold`, and the user name in the top bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Condo corporations and sites you manage or patrol.
styles.usage: Default reading text: table cells, messages, inputs, subtitles. One step larger than the usual 14px, because light text on black needs the room.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Linked row names in tables and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Each permit lasts 24 hours. Unused permits don’t carry over.
styles.usage: Field hints, second lines under a name, destructive row actions.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Licence plates, unit numbers, permit codes and timestamps: anything an officer reads character by character.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The seam: the black gap between frame segments, nav blocks and stacked bars. Also label-to-input gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles; gap between a card's header cap, title and bar; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; nav label inset from the block's right and bottom edges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Form field gaps; table column gutter; tile padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards; space under the PageHeader; content inset from the frame's inner corner.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Main content bottom padding; auth panel padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Auth screen top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Metro's square: tiles, cards, inputs, selects, the message body and table rows.

tokens.name: radius-cap
tokens.usage: End caps of 24px-tall bars: the top bar's right end and card header caps (half the bar height).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and Message caps: fully rounded ends.

tokens.name: radius-elbow
tokens.usage: The outer corner of the frame's one elbow (top-left).

tokens.name: radius-elbow-inner
tokens.usage: The inner corner where the elbow turns into the top bar.

tokens.name: frame-sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the elbow and the sidebar nav column.

tokens.name: frame-bar
tokens.usage: Thickness of the top bar and of every card header bar.

tokens.name: frame-elbow
tokens.usage: Height of the elbow block above the first nav block.

tokens.name: nav-item
tokens.usage: Height of one sidebar nav block.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Side of a square Tile; a wide tile is two tiles plus `space-2`.

tokens.name: max-w-content
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content column right of the sidebar.

tokens.name: max-w-sm
tokens.usage: Width of the auth column.

tokens.name: opacity-50
tokens.usage: Disabled and pending buttons.
